verdict.rationale: Kong's Konnect Dev Portal lets you publish APIs from OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specifications plus Markdown docs (kong-docs-49). Developers can then browse and search the rendered API documentation and try operations (kong-docs-21), with public or private, authenticated visibility (kong-docs-50, kong-docs-62). This covers the core story of generating and publishing docs from specs. Missing for 10: any evidence of generating docs from collections (not just specs), detail on the generation and publishing workflow (e.g. CLI or CI automation of portal publishing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
